def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==4]
    if not cells: return g
    c0=round(sum(c for r,c in cells)/len(cells))
    rows=[r for r,c in cells if c==c0]
    r0=max(rows) if rows else max(r for r,c in cells)
    for r in range(r0,H):
        g[r][c0]=4
    return g
